# Faith Haven House

> Faith Haven House is a 501(c)(3) non-profit transitional living facility for homeless men located in St. Charles County, Missouri. We empower single adult men facing housing insecurity to rebuild their lives, achieve self-sufficiency, and secure permanent housing through structured 122-day residential care, spiritual guidance, accountability, and comprehensive life-skills development.

## Core Program & Impact
- **Target Population:** Adult single men in St. Charles County, MO experiencing homelessness or transitional housing crises.
- **Housing Model:** 122-day average transitional stay offering safe shelter, nutritious meals, personal growth coaching, accountability, employment assistance, and housing stabilization.
- **Spiritual Foundation:** Faith-centered care honoring Christian principles while welcoming residents of all backgrounds.
- **Leadership & Legacy:** Founded by Dareth Jeffers (1960–2024). Governed by a dedicated Board of Directors led by Vice President HJ Hohensee, Executive Director Marshall Robinson, Board Members Tammy Conderman, Toni Lynch, and Treasurer Mike Keller.

## Key Services & Offerings
- **Transitional Shelter & Care:** Safe, clean residential accommodations for up to 122 days.
- **Personalized Case Management:** Individual recovery, employment, financial stewardship, and housing transition plans.
- **Life-Skills & Accountability:** Daily structure, curfew, drug/alcohol screening, budgeting assistance, and mentoring.
- **Community & Church Partnerships:** Collaboration with local churches, food pantries, employment networks, and health services.
